properties.displayName: UAV S103 - Relative Position Spoofing (Collision Induction)
properties.description: UAVSwarmComms_CL의 relative_position 메시지에서 RelativePositionReported가 RelativePositionExpectedRange(동적 배열 [min,max], meter)를 벗어난 상대위치 스푸핑·충돌유도 탐지. 기대 최소값 미만(과도한 근접)은 충돌 위험이 높아 High, 기대 최대값 초과(과도한 이격)는 Medium으로 세분화. MITRE: T0806 Brute Force I/O (ICS — description 참조)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let minSafeDistanceDeg = 0.0005;
UAVFleetState_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where (isnotnull(MinPairDistanceDeg) and MinPairDistanceDeg < minSafeDistanceDeg) or isnotempty(CollisionRiskPair)
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("상대위치스푸핑_충돌위험_최소간격_", tostring(MinPairDistanceDeg), "deg_위험쌍_", tostring(CollisionRiskPair))
| extend Severity = iff(isnotnull(MinPairDistanceDeg) and MinPairDistanceDeg < minSafeDistanceDeg, "High", "Medium")
| project TimeGenerated, FleetId, WindowStart, MinPairDistanceDeg, CollisionRiskPair, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S103 - Relative Position Spoofing (Collision Induction) - {{FleetId}}
